description: Switch the project system-of-record from docs/plans/STATUS.md to unblock itself (the MCP tracker configured here via mcp.json + AGENTS.md). STEP 1 (prerequisite): update CLAUDE.md + docs/PROCESS.md to instruct agents and future sessions to USE the unblock MCP (mcp.json) as the tracker — pick ready work via query/ready, register + update work via the issue/comment tools, and treat .unblock/issues.jsonl (the D5 committed export) as the git-backed record (re-export + commit issues.jsonl in the SAME commit as the work; close the issue on PR merge). STEP 2: reduce docs/plans/STATUS.md to a thin pointer stub -> unblock/issues.jsonl (the rich v1 M0-M3 history stays in git history). Zero-stale-hits on the 'STATUS.md is the system of record' framing across CLAUDE.md/PROCESS.md/plans-README. NOTE: unblock.db stays gitignored; issues.jsonl is the shared record until the v1.2 shared remote. Dogfood driver: bootstrap works via the harness, native mcp__unblock__* tools in a fresh session (mcp.json = cargo run --bin unblock mcp).
title: Repoint tracking from STATUS.md to unblock (MCP) — retire the STATUS file to a stub

comments.text: OUTCOME (Track). Codification LANDED on main (ff-merge -> 69bd2e0): CLAUDE.md folds the rule 'Every outcome is a comment on the task's issue' into the process-essentials paragraph, and docs/PROCESS.md §6 gains a dedicated bullet (the §5 drift/gap bullet was aligned to the same idiom). description: GAP found after the STATUS->unblock repoint: the process mentions the `comment` tool only parenthetically and never mandates that OUTCOMES live as comments. Codify in CLAUDE.md + docs/PROCESS.md (§6 Tracking): every phase/work/analysis result for a task — the Understand map, the Decide rationale + Miguel's fork resolutions, each gate verdict (design Review / Verify) with must-fixes, the Implement summary, findings, and the Track/merge result — is recorded as a COMMENT on the task's unblock issue (the `comment` tool). The issue's comment thread IS the durable, auditable per-task narrative that the verbose STATUS.md rows used to carry; .unblock/issues.jsonl snapshots it into git. No PRD D-id (process change). doc-lint must stay green.
title: Codify: every phase/work/analysis outcome is a comment on the task's unblock issue

description: Dogfood finding (2026-07-20). A `comment` add with the wrong body field (`content` instead of the required `body`) returned OK + empty structuredContent and persisted NOTHING (`comment list` = []), instead of a VALIDATION_FAILED. In an agent-first tracker this is SILENT data-loss — an agent believes the comment saved. Investigate whether it is rmcp arg-deserialization leniency (a missing required field accepted) or unblock's tool handling; make a malformed / missing-required comment add return a structured error, and add a test. Likely v1.0.1.
title: Bug: malformed `comment add` silently returns OK and persists nothing (data-loss risk)

description: Dogfood finding (2026-07-20). T3.9/D37 added the comments columns via a schema change with NO forward migration, so a `unblock.db` created BEFORE comments fails on the GA binary with `no such column: updated_at`. Fresh installs (init on GA) are fine, but there is NO upgrade path for an existing pre-comments DB. Fix: add a forward migration (schema_version bump + ALTER) so old DBs migrate cleanly + a migration regression test. Cousin of the migration-edit-drift lesson. Likely v1.0.1.
title: Bug: no forward-migration for the comments schema — pre-comments DBs break on the GA binary

description: Dogfood finding (2026-07-20). By design `init` does NOT create AGENTS.md (D27/AF-3: `agents` is a SEPARATE command), so a fresh `init` is not agent-ready until a second `unblock agents` call. Consider: (a) `init` prints a hint to run `unblock agents`, or (b) an opt-in `init --agents` that chains both (keeping the commands separate underneath). Keep D27/AF-3's separation; improve onboarding UX. v1.1 DX.
title: DX: `init` leaves the workspace agent-unwired (no AGENTS.md) — consider `init --agents`
